entries.german:
Konrad Richter und die Geschwornen der Stadt Budweis beurkunden den Verzicht des Gärbers Wernhart auf gewisse Erbansprüche im Goldenkroner Dorfe Oberplan.

Nos Conradus jud(e)x, Gebhardus, Vlr. Chrenaver, Johannes Boemus, Conr. de Ols 1, Nycol. Pilstinger, Nycol. pellif(e)x, Heinr. Paczaver, Hertreich, Martinus Bohemus, Nycol. Stollo, Vlr. sartor et Vlr. Bauarus iurati cives in Budyways recognoscimus persentium (sic, praesentium) inspectoribus universis publice protestantes, quod discretus vir Wernhardus cerdo nostrae civitatis incola una cum heredibus suis in praesentia nostri constituti bono ac deliberato animo non conpulsi non coacti (sic) sed de mera eorum voluntate omnem actionem seu quaestionem, quam adversus honorabilem virum dominum Theodricum abbatem nec non conventum monasterii Sanctae Coronae ordinis Cistarciensis super hereditate quadam in Plan 2 villa habere intenderunt et habuerunt, eisdem . . abbati et . . conventui pariter successoribus eorundem indulgentes relaxarunt, volentes quaestionem seu querelam deinceps nullam facere hereditare pro eadem seu aliis causis quibuscunque, et omnibus iuribus suis quae conpetebant, eis renunctiantes. In cuius rei testimonium praesentem copiam sigillo civitatis nostrae maiori iussimus consignari cum testibus subnotatis videlicet Frid. notario civitatis ipsius, Frid. de Sauraw 3, Conr. de Ols et Cristano, ceterisque viris fidedignis. Actum et Datum in Budyw(ays) anno domini millesimo trecentesimo tricesimo secundo, infra octavam nativitatis sanctae Mariae virginis gloriosae.
entries.english:
Conrad the Richter and the sworn councillors of the city of Budweis certify the waiver by the tanner Wernhart of certain inheritance claims in the Goldenkron village of Oberplan.

We Conrad, judge, Gebhard, Mr. Chrenaver, Johannes Boemus, Conr. de Ols, Nycol. Pilstinger, Nycol. the tanner's apprentice (pellifex), Heinr. Paczaver, Hertreich, Martinus Bohemus, Nycol. Stollo, Mr. the tanner (sartor) and Mr. Bauarus, sworn citizens of Budweis, acknowledge before all present and future readers publicly declaring that the discreet man Wernhart, a tanner and inhabitant of our city, with his heirs, standing in our presence, with good and deliberate mind, not compelled, not coerced (sic), but of their own free will, have granted and released to the aforementioned abbot and convent and their successors all action or dispute which they intended and had against the honorable man Lord Theodoric, abbot, as well as the convent of the monastery of the Holy Crown of the Cistercian order, concerning a certain inheritance in the village of Plan. They wish henceforth to make no further action or complaint regarding the same or any other causes, and renouncing all their rights that pertained, they declare them released. In testimony of this matter, we have ordered this copy to be sealed with the greater seal of our city, with the witnesses noted below: namely Frid. notary of the said city, Frid. de Sauraw, Conr. de Ols and Cristano, and other trustworthy men. Given and done in Budweis in the year of the Lord one thousand three hundred thirty-two, within the octave of the nativity of the glorious Virgin Mary.
